structure.unit: Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act

law.text:
The voting procedures in this chapter apply to:
A general, special, or primary election for federal office;
A general, special, or primary election for statewide or state legislative office or state referendum measure; and
A general, special, or primary election for local constitutional or government office or local referendum measure conducted under Chapter 6 (§ 24.2-600 et seq.) for which absentee voting is available for other voters.
